Subject: PO activation and VAT handling for Portugal freight services

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this. Quick summary — GreenWave Shipping Lda (PT) provides inbound freight and customs clearance into Portugal for Redwood's EU customers. Were ready to accept a Redwood PO but need to confirm how you want VAT handled on our invoices and whether a Portuguese fiscal representative is required for your setup.

Attachments: PT-Fiscal-Rep-Declaration.pdf (signed by our fiscal rep), GreenWave-VAT-Registration.pdf (certified copy)

Questions:
- Will Redwood accept invoices net of Portuguese VAT under reverse-charge (buyer-provided VAT number / fiscal rep exception), or do you require our invoices to include PT VAT?
- If Redwood wants us to register VAT or use a fiscal rep for reporting, do you have a preferred declaration template or PO routing for a Portuguese fiscal rep?
- Banking / invoice header: do you need the invoice addressed to a specific Redwood legal entity?

We can provide a sample XML invoice and bank details once you confirm the preferred path — attaching a sample invoice for reference.

Regards,
Simon Green
Head of Finance Ops | GreenWave Shipping Lda
accounts@greenwave.pt
Attachment: GreenWave-Sample-Invoice.xml

2) Is the PT-Fiscal-Rep-Declaration already signed by the Portuguese fiscal rep (the attached looks signed but we need a dated statement that covers FY2027)?
3) Do you currently invoice any other EU customers net of PT VAT under reverse-charge, or do you always include VAT?

Hi Sofia / team,

Thanks — quick answers below and attaching the signed PT-Fiscal-Rep-Declaration with a current date. We are a Portuguese-registered entity and our invoices default to include PT VAT (23%) unless buyer is able to provide a valid Portuguese VAT number and requests reverse-charge. Our fiscal rep has signed to act on our behalf for non-resident owners.

Answers:
- Invoice header (as registered): GreenWave Shipping Lda | NIPC PT123456789
- PT-Fiscal-Rep-Declaration: attached (signed 2027-04-15)
- We can issue invoices net of PT VAT if Redwood provides a Portuguese VAT ID to accept the reverse-charge; otherwise we must charge PT VAT.

Attachments: PT-Fiscal-Rep-Declaration.pdf, GreenWave-VAT-Registration.pdf. Bank details included in the sample invoice file.

If Redwood wants to avoid PT VAT on our invoices but cannot provide a PT VAT ID, the alternative is for GreenWave to keep charging VAT and Redwood to claim a VAT refund (longer). Let me know which you prefer and Laura/Ben if you need anything else from our side.

Best regards,
Simon
GreenWave Shipping Lda

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:00:00 +0100
Subject: Internal: Portugal VAT path for GreenWave (procurement guidance)

Sofia / Ben — internal note on recommended approach: 

- Preferred: Route PO and invoicing to Redwoods EU legal entity (Redwood Inference EU Services S.A.) with a valid EU VAT ID. That allows us to apply reverse-charge on intra-EU B2B services where appropriate. Please confirm with tax if the freight service is eligible for reverse-charge; usually freight between EU entities is B2B and reverse-charge applies, but local nuances exist.
- Alternate (if we cannot use EU VAT ID): Accept vendor invoices including PT VAT and process VAT reclaim via our VAT recovery team (longer).
- Fiscal rep: GreenWaves fiscal rep declaration on file is acceptable as vendor-side evidence; however we still need the invoice header to match the registered name and NIPC you provided.

Checklist before PO: 
1) Vendor onboarding form completed (Sofia has requested).
2) Copy of signed PT-Fiscal-Rep-Declaration (received).
3) Vendor confirms invoice header and bank details (received in sample invoice).
4) Procurement to create PO to Redwood Inference EU Services S.A. — include note: "Tax handling: reverse-charge if Redwood VAT ID supplied; else vendor charges PT VAT".

Ill mark PROC-784 with the recommended routing and attach the fiscal rep PDF. Ben, if youre okay with routing to Redwood Inference EU Services S.A., Ill approve PO issuance.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
